candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Di pikin get diarrhoea. No get cough or e no dey breathe hard. No ear wahala. No fever. Di stool no get blood inside am. As I check, di way e dey drink na normal. Im eyes no sink. If I pinch im skin, e return normal. Di pikin no restless or dey vex. Im never get convulsion before. E no dey convulse now. E no dey weak or dey like person wey no sabi anything. Im fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything.
